title: Film vocabulary as prompt tokens with Auto defaults and preview loops
gap: lib/studio.ts CATEGORIES already holds shot size, angle, camera move (with long anti-confusion modules), lens, light, time, look, technique, mood and pace. lib/previews.ts and GET /api/platform/previews serve neutral preview loops made on the platform. Only the legacy components/make/Composer.tsx uses them; GenView's Direction box is a bare textarea. Admission already stores body.shotSpec (generationAdmission.ts:1712-1745).
target: Under Direction, add chips 'Shot · Angle · Camera · Lens · Light · Look', each defaulting to Auto. Each chip opens a popover grid in which every option shows its preview loop (muted, preload='none', plays only while visible or hovered), its label and its aka. Typing '#' in the textarea opens a typeahead of moves. Selections are sent as shotSpec and appended the way lib/studio.ts specifies, and Recreate restores them.
respects_rules: The previews are Particl's own platform assets, not Higgsfield media. The price is re-quoted whenever the prompt changes. No serif fonts are introduced.
